description:
Executable buy-on-marketplace, sell-on-Steam flips. Every skin that can be bought on a third-party marketplace for less than it nets on Steam Community Market
right now, as rust.wiki/skins/deals computes it. Per deal: `buy_market` and `buy_price` (the cheapest in-stock
listing we poll, cents), `sell_url` (the Steam listing page), the two Steam references `bid_gross`/`bid_net`
(highest buy order, and what you actually receive after Steam's 15% fee) and `ask_gross`/`ask_net` (lowest
sell order, same), then for the chosen `steam_ref`: `sell_price` (the net proceeds), `sell_gross`,
`spread_abs` (cents) and `spread_pct`. Only rows profitable under the chosen reference are returned. A stale
buy order above a fresher ask is capped at the ask. Filters combine with AND; `search` matches the skin name
case-insensitively. Marketplace links are not included. Recomputed every ~5 minutes from the marketplace
poll.

marketplace.description: Only deals whose cheapest listing is on one of these marketplaces (repeat the parameter).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring of the skin name (or Steam market name).

sort.description: Best `pct` (spread as % of buy price) or `abs` (spread in cents) first.

steam_ref.description: Steam exit price: `buy` = sell instantly into the highest buy order (default), `sell` = list just under the lowest sell order.

name: find_skin_deals
title: Executable buy-on-marketplace, sell-on-Steam flips
